name: lh1storm
description: Load harness LH-1 driver extension — exposes lh1storm:1:burst(count, bytes) which fires count parallel pubsub.publish calls on plinth:ext:lh1storm:storm_event to drive the v0.5.0 Layer-3 emit path under sustained storm load. Named lh1storm (not ICD's ext_lh1_storm) because manifest name and channel-extension segment both reject underscores.
author: plinth-load-harness
